entries.name: Lantern Wardens
entries.motto: Every flame counted. Every shadow named.
entries.description: Akeboshi City's quiet guardians. Each Warden carries a blade tempered in a shrine lantern and keeps a ledger of every soul-flame in their district. After the Seven-Minute Eclipse they recruit the player as a probationary 'Wick'.
entries.combat_identity: Balanced blade fighters who punish enemy attacks with parries and flame arcs.

entries.name: Skyreader Observatory
entries.motto: Chart the dark, and it cannot surprise you.
entries.description: Astronomers of the hidden capital who fire condensed starlight. They believe the eclipse was predicted in an erased page of their star charts.
entries.combat_identity: Ranged fighters who mark enemies with star-points, then link and detonate the marks.

entries.name: Omokage Troupe
entries.motto: Wear the face of those who came before.
entries.description: Travelling festival dancers whose carved masks hold the echoes of their ancestors. A dancer changes masks mid-performance and fights in the style of whoever the mask remembers.
entries.combat_identity: Stance switchers: swapping masks mid-combo changes moveset and transforms the dancer.

entries.name: Paper Court
entries.motto: What is folded with care, obeys with care.
entries.description: Archivist-summoners who fold talismans into living paper familiars. They guard the Thousand Stacks, the archive beneath the capital.
entries.combat_identity: Summoners who fight through paper familiars that scout, shield and swarm.

entries.name: Bellhold Monastery
entries.motto: Strike true, and the soul rings back.
entries.description: Mountain monks who train the soul like a temple bell. Every clean hit adds resonance until the monk releases it as a shockwave. Their great bell has fallen silent.
entries.combat_identity: Unarmed martial artists who build resonance with hits and release it in area bursts.

entries.name: The Unlit
entries.motto: No flame, no shadow, no trace.
entries.description: Outcasts who dimmed their own soul-flames so the Gloam cannot see them. Distrusted by every other faction, they become uneasy allies during the war.
entries.combat_identity: High-mobility assassins who blink through shadows and strike from behind.

entries.name: Penumbral Synod
entries.description: Rulers of the Gloam. They believe a soul-flame only exists to be lost, and plan a permanent eclipse of the Sun Below so no soul burns out again. Enemy faction, not playable.
entries.combat_identity: Enemy faction: commanders who shape the Gloam into soldiers.
